info.title: Swell Travel Agent API
info.description: Surf-forecast-driven travel discovery. All state-changing requests need the session cookie and an `X-CSRF-Token` header matching the `sta_csrf` cookie (GET `/api/auth/csrf` first).

get.description:
Data freshness and background-job health (ok / degraded / failing, with reasons).

Public on purpose, like /api/system/status: it holds operational metadata only (run
keys, ages, limits, job statuses, reasons written by the service; no personal data,
no raw error text), and an external uptime monitor must be able to read it without
credentials, because a dead worker cannot send its own alert. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
Disable email alerts using the secret token from an alert email.

Supports RFC 8058 one-click (form POST with ``List-Unsubscribe=One-Click`` and the
token in the URL) and the web page (JSON body ``{"token": "..."}``). No session
needed: possession of the per-user token is the authorisation.

AttributionLinkOut.title: AttributionLinkOut
AttributionLinkOut.description: A credit or licence link the data source asks for (shown next to the data).

Conditions.title: Conditions
Conditions.description:
One forecast hour at a spot. Two kinds of numbers live here, kept apart on purpose:

* raw model data from the forecast source (offshore ``sig_wave_height_m``, swell and
  wind fields), and
* our predictions (``breaking_height_*``, ``score``/``label``, ``confidence``).

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Plain reasons, the most severe first

EmailDeliveryOut.title: EmailDeliveryOut
EmailDeliveryOut.description:
What happened to an account email, in provider terms. ``captured`` means a
development inbox kept it (nothing was delivered to a real mailbox).

HeartbeatOut.title: HeartbeatOut
HeartbeatOut.description: Newest finished background job of any kind (the data-health job excluded).

MapSnapshotOut.title: MapSnapshotOut
MapSnapshotOut.description: Every monitored spot at one forecast time, from cached predictions only.

ModelSeries.title: ModelSeries
ModelSeries.description: Raw output of one numerical model (or our blend) at this spot, 3-hourly.

PartitionOut.title: PartitionOut
PartitionOut.description: One wave system of the model; only systems the model provides are listed.

RedisHealthOut.title: RedisHealthOut
RedisHealthOut.description:
Redis (Celery broker, locks, call budgets, provider response cache): memory used
against its cap. With ``noeviction`` a full Redis refuses writes, so new jobs fail.

ResearchOut.title: ResearchOut
ResearchOut.description: How well the spot's ideal conditions are understood (not forecast confidence).

RunMemberOut.title: RunMemberOut
RunMemberOut.description: One model run behind a forecast (a blend member, or the single source itself).

StepBreakingOut.title: StepBreakingOut
StepBreakingOut.description: Our predicted breaking (face) height at the break, in feet.

StepOffshoreOut.title: StepOffshoreOut
StepOffshoreOut.description: Raw offshore model sea state (significant height, not surf height).

StepSegmentOut.title: StepSegmentOut
StepSegmentOut.description:
A stretch of steps with the same spacing: ``start`` is the first step of the stretch,
``end`` its last step plus one step.

StepWhyOut.title: StepWhyOut
StepWhyOut.description: What drove the score: factor fits and gates (0..1), points lost per factor.

TidePreferenceOut.title: TidePreferenceOut
TidePreferenceOut.description: The spot's researched tide preference, and how far it can be trusted.
